approval.block-decided: Already decided (%s); it cannot be decided again.
approval.block-expired: This approval has expired; the caller must request it again.
approval.block-self: Self-approval blocked: another admin must decide
approval.linked-missing: Linked approval %s is not in the recent records.
approval.local-mode-hint: Local guardrail mode: decided with the desktop process admin token
policy.actor-ignored-local: actor %s (local mode applies to every call)

policy.actor-local-placeholder: Local mode applies to every call
policy.delete-confirm-body: Later calls stop matching it immediately (%s).
policy.err-invalid-form: Invalid form value. Pick the effect and access again.
policy.global-hint: Also applies to unbound / credential-less calls
policy.mode-local-desc: The gateway serves this machine only and caller identity is self-declared. Restrictions match by repository / service / tool, ignore actor, and apply to every call.
policy.mode-shared-desc: The gateway is shared across identities and matches rules by authenticated identity; actor-scoped rules apply only to that identity or group.
policy.no-rules: No restrictions yet. Calls follow the baseline grants above.
policy.rules-note: Deny / Approve · tightens the baseline grants
policy.sim-subtitle: Identity cap → explicit Deny → repo baseline → explicit Approve
policy.trust-declared-hint: Identity is self-declared; it is a local guardrail, not an authenticated boundary.
skills.allowlist-hint: Use * for all repositories / services, or comma-separated IDs; empty admits none.
skills.delete-confirm-body: Calls declaring skill_id = %s will be denied after deletion.
skills.empty: No admitted skills. Calls without a skill_id are unaffected; calls declaring an unlisted skill_id are denied.
skills.err-allowlist: Scope must be a single * or comma-separated valid IDs
skills.err-id: skill_id may contain only letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens
skills.name: Name
skills.note: Declarative guardrail (skill_trust = declared): checked only when a call explicitly declares a skill_id.
skills.title: Skill admission allowlist
